relations.description: Transmission failure of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message is guarded by TAI change condition.
Transmission failure of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message is guarded by no TAI change condition.
Condition where current TAI is not in TAI list establishes aborting GUTI reallocation procedure.
Condition where current TAI is not in TAI list establishes initiating tracking area updating procedure.
Condition where current TAI is in TAI list establishes UE implementation re-run behavior.
Condition of no TAI change establishes UE implementation re-run behavior.
Abort property stops the GUTI reallocation procedure.
Initiate property starts the tracking area updating procedure.
